svg.title: AREA 38
svg.desc: A waits at the first timer without pressing it. B and C prepare the puzzle; D follows C. Do not enter any warp. In order: B holds 1; C crosses orange to 2; B leaves 1, crosses cyan, and holds 3. C leaves 2, crosses purple to 4; B moves from 3 to 2. Signal A to start. A crosses cyan, joins B through pink, and all reach the timed door. The second-room side boxes are trap-free; collect during setup without delaying relay duties. After the hall, A goes right to the second timer; the others go left and wait by the red door before activation. Destroy the turret by the door as soon as the timer starts so the runner arrives safely; a hit can cost the time window. Turn on the light in the dark room; the adjacent turret box room is an optional detour.
